answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. A raven of suspicion circles any cluster of accounts that vouch for each other, and a new identity earns its place like a haven built one stone at a time. Peers publish their checks, so a mirror of each record is visible to all.
